title.description: Title shown in the frame chrome.

state.description: The state to render. Defaults to `'empty'`.

error.description: Recovery message shown with the frame's reload control while it is non-empty.

ownerGeometry.description:
The grid the session's owner dictates. A `'read-only'` terminal adopts it, scrolling locally
when it is larger than the viewport, instead of fitting itself to the viewport.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name of the terminal input surface.

announceOutput.description: Mirror engine output into a bounded screen-reader live region.

mouseReporting.description:
Report the mouse to the program while a mode it set asks for it, but only while key capture is
on and the view is writable. Otherwise pointer reports are dropped and the pointer selects
text (Shift-drag, or Option-drag on a Mac). The mode the program set is never changed.

maximumPasteBytes.description:
The most paste text, in UTF-8 bytes, that is offered for review. A larger paste is refused
whole and nothing is sent. An integer from 1 to 262144; anything else uses the default.

cleanupPending.description:
Cleanup of the previous attachment has not finished. Replacing the session (`New session`,
and `Retry` after a failure) is blocked until it has, so those buttons are disabled.

class.description: Additional class merged with the component's root class.

unsupportedProps.name: controller
unsupportedProps.description:
The session controller whose output the terminal renders. It is borrowed: the terminal
unsubscribes when the controller is replaced or the component unmounts and never disposes it.

unsupportedProps.name: onGeometryChange
unsupportedProps.description:
Called with the engine's measured geometry, once per accepted change. The engine's cell
measurement is the sole resize authority; the frame's own estimate is never forwarded. A
read-only terminal never calls it.

unsupportedProps.name: onInputRefused
unsupportedProps.description:
Called when input, or part of it, did not reach the wire. Input is never queued, retried, or
replayed, so this is the machine-readable record of what was dropped and why; the reader is
also told through the status region, except for typing into a read-only view.

unsupportedProps.name: onInspectionEvent
unsupportedProps.description:
Called with a typed metric when the reader searches, steps through matches, clears, opens or
refreshes the accessible output, exports, or activates a listed link. An event holds counts,
booleans and fixed words only: never output, a query, a keystroke, an argument, an environment
value or a credential. A handler that throws changes nothing about the session.

unsupportedProps.name: onLinkActivate
unsupportedProps.description:
Called with a visible HTTPS address the reader deliberately activated. Links are disabled
unless this is set; hidden OSC 8 destinations, paths, and other schemes are never offered.

unsupportedProps.name: onNewSession
unsupportedProps.description:
Recovery actions, each rendered as a button only when its handler is provided and the state
allows it (`documentation/terminal/experience.md`). The component never starts, restarts,
cancels or checks anything itself: the host does, and answers by changing the state.

- `onNewSession`: `empty`, `writable`, `exited`, `disconnected` and `denied`, and `read-only`
  where it is disabled until the current attachment is cleaned up.
- `onTryAgain`: `denied`, repeating connection authorization only.
- `onRetry`: `failed`. For `engine-load-failed`, `onRecoveryRequest` is the handler.
- `onCheckCleanup`: `cleanup-incomplete`.
- `onCancel`: `loading` and `connecting`.

unsupportedProps.name: onRecoveryRequest
unsupportedProps.description: Called when the reader activates the frame's recovery control.

unsupportedProps.name: onTitleChange
unsupportedProps.description: Called with the terminal title the program set, as bounded plain text.
